dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT tasp.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, tasp.position_id, tp.position_title,tasp.process_moved_date, CASE WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to = ? THEN 'Joined' WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to IN (?, ?, ?, ?) THEN 'Rejected' WHEN tasp.position_step_id_to = '-1' THEN 'On Hold' WHEN tps.position_step_level=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', tps.position_step_title, ')') WHEN (SELECT application_property_value FROM tp_application_properties WHERE application_property=?) = ? THEN CASE WHEN tps.position_step_isscheduled=? THEN concat('In Process', ' (', tps.position_step_title, ')') ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', tps.position_step_title, ')') END ELSE concat('In Process', ' (', tps.position_step_title, ')') END AS activity FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tps ON(tasp.position_step_id_to=tps.position_step_id) ,tp_applicants ta ,tp_positions tp , tp_position_vendors tpv WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id AND tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tp.position_id= tpv.position_id AND ta.source_id=tpv.source_id AND ta.vendor_id=? AND ta.source_id=? @@ @@ @@ ORDER BY tasp.process_moved_date DESC LIMIT ?, ?

SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp ,tp_applicants ta ,tp_positions tp , tp_position_vendors tpv WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id AND tasp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tp.position_id= tpv.position_id AND ta.source_id=tpv.source_id AND ta.vendor_id=? AND ta.source_id=? @@ @@ @@
SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_title FROM tp_positions tp, tp_position_vendors tpv WHERE tp.position_id = tpv.position_id AND tpv.source_id=? AND tp.position_status = ? ORDER BY tp.position_title
